headline: Apollo and Singapore’s Keppel to Invest in New Offshore Energy Asset Fund
summary: SINGAPORE and NEW YORK, July 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Apollo (NYSE: APO) today announced that Apollo-managed funds and affiliates (“Apollo Funds”) have agreed to invest $1.5 billion into Keppel Ltd.’s (SGX: BN4) Keppel Offshore Fund, LP (“the Fund”), that will hold a portfolio of offshore energy assets, managed by Keppel.
